topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen- and damage-associated molecular patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular injury by identifying conserved non-self molecular patterns.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptors and intracellular signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the genetics, cellular localization, and downstream signaling pathways of innate pattern recognition receptors and inflammasome complexes.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell extravasation into tissues, facilitate lymphatic priming, and trigger systemic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Inflammation resolution, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the active and passive mechanisms that terminate inflammation, orchestrate tissue repair, and lead to chronic inflammatory structures like granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
